name: Inbox
description: One calm inbox across the mailboxes Email Triage watches: what survived triage (with the reason it was kept) and what hasn't been triaged yet, never mixed. Archive, delete and undo in one key or swipe, replies with AI suggest/polish, and one key to hand a thread to Lucidos. Each account's folders and labels fold away in the sidebar, to open in the same list when needed.
